llm_response.reason: The site displays numerous scam warning signs: guaranteed returns ('profitability from day one'), unverifiable testimonials, urgency tactics, ambiguous regulatory claims ('regulated by the GSE, USA' and 'Financial Conduct Authority' without proof), unusual incentives (no deposit/withdrawal fees, deposit bonus, high leverage), and does not link to any real regulators or partners. WHOIS info is not available, which may indicate privacy shielding. All these fit classic characteristics of cryptocurrency scam websites.
